entities.summary: Masivesi Dakuwaqa is a Fijian rugby footballer. Dakuwaqa formerly played rugby sevens for Fiji, including at the 2016 Summer Olympics and rugby league for the Canberra Raiders in the National Rugby League. He represented Biarritz in the French D2 but was fired after a biting incident involving team mate Pierre Pàges which required 20 stitches. He was arrested by the police and appeared in court in May 2025. He was signed by Nationale 1 side CA Périgueux as a medical joker.
